note: USACE campground in open oak grassland above Eastman Lake on the Chowchilla River, near Buchanan Dam; the lake is a designated trophy bass fishery. Three sites have horse corrals. The nearest store and fuel are about 20 miles away. --Claude
summary: Wildcat (USACE Eastman Lake): $20 year-round, 19 reservable sites, paved 37-60 ft spurs, water/dump/showers; HORSE RULE: the 3 equestrian sites (W16-W18) share the single loop with the standard sites - drop candidate; not waterfront kept; phone added.
